summary: Biddance AI Systems, Inc., a Xiamen-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting completion of the second and final closing, on October 29, 2026, of its acquisition of Ju Fu Limited (BVI), parent of the Beijing Fourth Coco advertising and digital marketing business, from MAI THI MY UT under an August 3, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement. The second closing comprised US$5,000,000 cash plus 4,000,000 Class A ordinary shares subject to lock-up, leak-out and forfeiture terms; up to US$3,000,000 deferred cash remains contingent on performance targets. Ju Fu is now a wholly owned subsidiary; watch deferred-earnout achievement and share overhang.
